column1: Complete system installation accepted by Aker Kvaerner Chemetics Field Supervisor. (See signed Contractor Field Check List)
Observe Hi pot and megger tests on HV cables.
Check shield connections on HV cables (both ends).
If single conductor HV and LV power cables with metal armour have been used make certain non-ferrous termination plates are used.  (circulating currents).
Get signed copy (from contractor) for megger, continuity and correct termination tests for all cables.
